name: ship-check
description: Three independent read-only checks in parallel (behaviour, accessibility and design, contest rules), merged into one report. Run before every deploy and before submitting.

branches.prompt: Review the whole of src for behavioural bugs against .kiro/specs/*/requirements.md: determinism, garbled frames, collisions, known-set correctness, reload recovery. Do not edit files. Cite file and line.

Run the checks, then read src/ui against .kiro/steering/design-language.md and the accessibility requirements in the consoles and seance-replay specs. Write findings to reports/workflow/experience.md.

Read the 'Submission checklist' in docs/END-GOAL.md. Check each item against the repository (licence file, .kiro at root and not ignored, README run instructions, no secrets, no third-party trademarks or copyrighted audio). Do not edit source. Write a pass/fail table with evidence to reports/workflow/rules.md.

steps.prompt:
Merge the three check results (the behaviour review output below, reports/workflow/experience.md and reports/workflow/rules.md) into reports/workflow/ship-check.md: blocking issues first, then the rest, deduplicated, each with file and line.

{{behaviour.output}}
